overall_reason: Three update behaviors touch the suite. (1) Learners now vote: VoteContract's learner silence and LearnerEligibility's grant conjunct are relaxed (campaign conjunct and all vote-safety conditions kept). (2) RawNode.Ready() now consumes output and Advance() no longer clears it: ReadyOwnership's raw branch changes, a new AdvanceOutputRetention obligation is added with an acks-observer extension, and the lostReads observer behind ReadyAccounting is migrated (same predicate text, different meaning). (3) Snapshot restore and restart rebuild the full joint ConfState: JointSnapshotRecovery and ConfigurationOrigin already require this and are kept unchanged (the old implementation violated them; the new one satisfies them). The Update.tla reachability canary for joint recovery is migrated. All other properties are kept as safety controls. Executed TLC witnesses and Go observations on both trees confirmed every initial decision; no decision changed. Guarded simulation of the proposed model additionally exposed two PRE-EXISTING implementation hazards, reproduced identically in the old and new Go code and in both models (campaign over a pending ConfChangeV2; singleton self-election after restart replay with allowed early Advance). The unchanged CampaignDecisionEligibility and ElectionSafety correctly reject them and are kept.

suspected_defects_not_to_hide: new restore() still checks self-membership only in cs.Voters and cs.Learners: an outgoing-only voter (here also in LearnersNext) ignores the joint snapshot in both old and new code (E10). Progress issue, pre-existing; no property edit masks it.
Old implementation violates JointSnapshotRecovery/ConfigurationOrigin on joint restore/restart (E7, E8); the properties stay unchanged.

Old base.tla AdvanceCore cleared raw readStates unconditionally while old acceptReady clears only when rd.ReadStates is non-empty; the old lostReads guard masked the resulting model loss (E6b, confirmed by old Go code retaining rd2).
TestLearnerCanVote is too weak: it passes on a learner that always rejects (E2e, executed mutant).

NEW (found by guarded simulation, pre-existing): numOfPendingConf counts only EntryConfChange, so nodes campaign while a committed ConfChangeV2 is unapplied (E12; old and new code). Caught by the unchanged CampaignDecisionEligibility.

NEW (found by guarded simulation, pre-existing): restart without snapshot + replay of bootstrap conf entries + early Advance (allowed by node.go:164-167) lets a node win alone in a partial singleton config while a majority elects another leader in the same term (E15; old and new code). Caught by the unchanged ElectionSafety; QuorumAccounting does not catch it.
Learner votes rely on candidates' configs being current (code comment references etcd issue 7625); ElectionSafety/QuorumAccounting remain required.
unresolved_obligations: Liveness motivation for learner voting (promoted-but-unaware learner enables election) is only expressible via ElectionProgress, which this suite does not model-check.
Snapshot acceptance by outgoing-only voters during joint configs (E10) - progress obligation, no property proposed.
Trace instrumentation must rename ConfState fields (Nodes->Voters, NodesJoint->VotersOutgoing) and drop RawNode accept-at-Advance; outside the property suite.

Reachable-state non-vacuity for learner grants (E13) and for joint recovery (E9b) was not achieved by bounded/random search; evidence for those edits rests on mapped constant-level/action witnesses and Go observations.
Whether the restart-replay early-Advance hazard (E15) is an implementation defect or a caller-contract gap (Bootstrap via log entries is discouraged in NewRawNode's doc) is not settled by the inputs.
